description: This Java source file defines the ProductImagesController class, a Spring MVC controller responsible for managing product images within an admin interface. It includes handlers for listing, paginating, saving, and deleting product images, utilizing various services and utilities related to products, images, and merchant stores.

classes.name: ProductImagesController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller managing CRUD operations for product images in the admin interface.

methods.name: displayProductImages
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the list of images for a specific product.

methods.name: pageProductImages
methods.description: Handles POST requests to return paginated product images in JSON format.

methods.name: saveProductImages
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save uploaded product images.

methods.name: deleteImage
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a specific product image.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets the menu model attributes for the UI.
